Johny I Love You
Following the death of his wife, former criminal Suraj Singh takes his renamed son and moves to work in a small hillside community. Starring Sanjay Dutt, Rati Agnihotri, Suresh Oberoi.
Viduthalai Part 1
A police officer tries to capture the leader of a separatist group. Starring Soori, Vijay Sethupathi, Gautham Menon.
Naya Kadam

Madhukar and Jaggu are Hitler-like tyrants who rule over a small community with an iron hand. They prefer to keep the inhabitants illiterate, so that they can continue to oppress and abuse them over time. Starring Rajesh Khanna, Sridevi, Padmini Kolhapure.
Avinash

Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen items, finds himself in a fix when he accidentally gets a videotape and is hunted by goons. Things take a turn for the worse when he loses his memory after being attacked. Starring Mithun Chakravarty, Poonam Dhillon, Parveen Babi.
100 Days of Love

Balan, a columnist, falls in love with his schoolmate Sheela when they meet after many years. But his happiness is short-lived when he learns that she is engaged to someone else. Starring Dulquer Salmaan, Nithya Menon, Sekhar Menon.
James Pandu

Two porters cum ex-friends, who have a fall-out because of their love interests, have to rob the same person. The man, who gave them the job, is trying to scam both of them and take the money without being involved. Starring Parthiban, Prabhu Deva, Kausalya.
Sweekar Kiya Maine

Gopika Sharma is taken to Bombay by her uncle to help her pursue a career in singing; when he is abducted, Gopika and her servant must fend for themselves. Starring Vinod Mehra, Shabana Azmi, Prema Narayan.
Teri Kasam
A rich girl falls in love with an aspiring musician, but after they marry, their egos cause them to drift apart. Starring Kumar Gaurav, Poonam Dhillon, Girish Karnad.
Pighalta Aasman

A businesswoman travels to Kashmir to settle a property issue; she falls in love with a man there. Her best friend also falls in love with the same person, this changes their relationship forever. Starring Shashi Kapoor, Rakhee Gulzar, Rati Agnihotri.
Keemat

Ajay and Dev feel guilty after they accidentally kill a young man. When they visit the boy's family but cannot bring themselves to speak the truth, they decide to stay and make amends in secret. Starring Akshay Kumar, Raveena Tandon, Saif Ali Khan.
Zakhmi Aurat

Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law into her own hands and seeks revenge by devastating means. Starring Dimple Kapadia, Raj Babbar, Anupam Kher.
